entries.en: Good job, Shepard. Thanks to you, the Council's finally taking real action against Saren!
The ambassador is correct. If Saren is foolish enough to attack the Citadel--as you believe--we will be ready for him.
Patrols are stationed at every mass relay linking Citadel space to the Terminus Systems.
Ilos is only accessible through the Mu Relay, deep inside the Terminus Systems, Commander. If we send a fleet in there, the only possible outcome is full-scale war.
There are serious political implications here, Shepard. Humanity's made great gains thanks to you. But now you're becoming more trouble than you're worth.
Ambassador Udina, I get the sense Commander Shepard isn't willing to let this go.
It's just politics, Commander. You've done your job, now let me do mine. We've locked out all the Normandy's primary systems. Until further notice, you're grounded.
I think it's time for you and your team to leave, Commander. This no longer concerns you. The Council can handle this. With my help, of course.
How many ships are you sending to attack Ilos?
You think a blockade's going to stop him? He's on Ilos looking for the Conduit right now! What are you doing about that?
If Saren finds the Conduit, we're all screwed! We have to go to Ilos!
Are you insane? After everything I've done, you still don't believe me?
What about Ilos?
That's it?
It's not over!
This is stupid!
Now is the time for discretion, Commander. Saren's greatest weapon was secrecy. Exposed, he is no longer a threat. This is over.
Only you have seen the Reapers. And then only in visions. We won't invade the Terminus Systems because of a dream.
Saren is a master manipulator. The Conduit is just a distraction from his real plan to attack the Citadel.
You detonated a nuclear device on Virmire. I wouldn't call that discreet!
Your style served you well in the Traverse, Commander. We recognize that. But Ilos requires a deft touch. We have the situation under control.
You bastard! You're selling us out!
You bastard! You're selling us out!
The bastard's selling you out!
I think your ambassador just sold us out.
I think your ambassador just sold us out.
Sovereign's the real threat! Saren's just a servant of the Reapers.
Secrecy isn't his greatest weapon. The Conduit is!
One ship going into the Terminus Systems won't start a war. I can be discreet.
Nobody stabs me in the back, Udina. Nobody.
What about the Reapers?
What about the Conduit?
Send me after him.
Then you're all fools!
The Conduit's real!
No you don't!
This is a mistake!
You son of a bitch.
That's not enough.
